summary: Valens Semiconductor Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 14, 2026, disclosing that its Board of Directors appointed Asaf Silberstein as a Class II director on September 10, 2026, to serve until the 2029 annual general meeting. Silberstein is Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer of Semtech Corporation. The filing is a routine board-appointment disclosure, not a forced or abrupt departure, and includes no transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock. No deal or special-situation mechanics apply; no risk-arb angle.
